verses.gurmukhi: ਬੇਸ੍ਵਾ ਕੇ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਬਿਬਿਚਾਰ ਕੋ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਰਤਾਰ ਕਾ ਕੀ ਨਾਰ ਕੈ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: besavaiaa ke si(n)gaar bibichaar ko na paar paieeaai bin bharataar kaa kee naar kai bulaieeaai ||

en.bdb: The embellishments of a whore and her relationships with many men cannot be fathomed. Without a husband, whose wife can she be known as?

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਗੁ ਸੇਤ ਜੀਵ ਘਾਤ ਕਰਿ ਖਾਤ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੋ ਮੋਨਿ ਗਹਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਧਰੇ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: bag set jeev ghaat kar khaat kete ko mon geh dhiaan dhare jugat na paieeaai ||

en.bdb: A heron is white like a swan but it kills many living beings to appease his appetite. To do this evil act, he stands in perfect silence, but in doing so, he does not achieve the know-how of yog.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਂਡ ਕੀ ਭੰਡਾਈ ਬੁਰਵਾਈ ਨ ਕਹਤ ਆਵੈ ਅਤਿ ਹੀ ਢਿਠਾਈ ਸੁਕਚਤ ਨ ਲਜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: bhaa(n)dd kee bha(n)ddaiee buravaiee na kahat aavai at hee ddiThaiee sukachat na lajaieeaai ||

en.bdb: One cannot explain the shamelessness of the actions and words used by a mimic. He does not shy away from using bad words out of sheer obstinacy.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਦੂਖਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਦੋਖ ਮਮ ਅਧਮ ਅਨੇਕ ਏਕ ਰੋਮ ਨ ਪੁਜਾਈਐ ॥੫੨੨॥
verses.translit_en: taise par tan dhan dhookhan tiradhokh mam adham anek ek rom na pujaieeaai ||522||

en.bdb: Similarly, like these low character people, I am low too. I am a chronic patient of the three diseases, that is looking at others wealth, woman and slandering others. Numerous sinners cannot match even a hair of my sinful life. I am lowest of all the low characters.  (522)
